about_the_game:
Bear the honoured colours of the Space Wolves with the Space Wolves Chapter Pack!

This DLC contains a Champion skin, a cosmetic set, three weapon skins and is available with the Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 Season Pass.

Champion Pack:

Get a full-body Space Wolves Champion skin for the Vanguard.

Weapon Skin Pack:

Receive three Weapon skins for the Chainsword, Thunder Hammer and Bolt Carbine.

Cosmetic Pack:

Over 50 cosmetic items and decals from 12 Space Wolves Great Companies. See below.
